test_title: PYST 6 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 14 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: In a particular code language, if TELESCOPE is coded as 20-5-12-5-19-3-15-16-5 and MICROSCOPE is coded as 13-9-3-18-15-19-3-15-16-5, then what is the code for STETHOSCOPE?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cc2e23d475850ec06adc3436a7e27d678f42f2ddcc06ac05545301810b15f3a7.png] 

Logic: **Each letter is replaced by its alphabetical position number.**

TELESCOPE is coded as 20-5-12-5-19-3-15-16-5

T → 20
E → 5
L → 12
E → 5
S → 19
C → 3
O → 15
P → 16
E → 5

MICROSCOPE is coded as 13-9-3-18-15-19-3-15-16-5

M → 13
I → 9
C → 3
R → 18
O → 15
S → 19
C → 3
O → 15
P → 16
E → 5

Similarly, **STETHOSCOPE** is coded as:

S → 19
T → 20
E → 5
T → 20
H → 8
O → 15
S → 19
C → 3
O → 15
P → 16
E → 5

So, **STETHOSCOPE** will be coded as

**19-20-5-20-8-15-19-3-15-16-5**

Hence, the correct option is **Option 1**
